name: – Adam Jarubas – Article 1 – § 1 – point 1; Directive 2003/87/EC – Article 10a – after § 2b – Am 16
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030
part_text: 2ba. Where sector-specific benchmarks or sub-benchmarks are introduced pursuant to this paragraph, the Commission shall ensure that the introduction and application of such benchmarks or sub-benchmarks does not delay, reduce or otherwise adversely affect the free allocation of allowances to any sector or sub-sector for the period from 2026 to 2030. Where necessary to ensure compliance with this requirement, the Commission may make available additional allowances for free allocation through a transfer from the Market Stability Reserve established by Decision (EU) 2015/1814. Where the determination of such benchmarks or sub-benchmarks would delay free allocation, the Commission shall proceed with allocation on the basis of the applicable Union-wide benchmark without prejudice to the determination of the relevant sector-specific benchmarks or sub-benchmarks.
